# Carolina Pro Restoration LLC

> 24/7 emergency water damage restoration, mold remediation, crawlspace encapsulation, and licensed reconstruction for Fort Mill, Rock Hill, and York County, SC, plus Charlotte, NC and surrounding areas. One IICRC-certified team handles everything from cleanup to the finished rebuild, with direct insurance billing. Emergency line: (980) 277-3700.

Key facts:

- Phone (24/7 emergency dispatch): (980) 277-3700
- Address: 3650 Centre Circle, Suite I, Fort Mill, SC 29715
- Licensed and insured in SC and NC (SC License #70177448); IICRC-certified technicians; BBB Accredited Business (A+ rating); RIA member; 40+ five-star Google reviews
- Response: 60-minute response goal — trucks reach most of York County and south Charlotte in under an hour
- Insurance: estimates written in Xactimate, direct carrier billing, works directly with adjusters, daily photo and moisture documentation
- Service area: Fort Mill, Rock Hill, Tega Cay, Indian Land, Clover, Lake Wylie, Lancaster, and York, SC; Charlotte, Pineville, Waxhaw, Ballantyne, Matthews, Belmont, Gastonia, Indian Trail, Mint Hill, Monroe, Mount Holly, Stallings, and Weddington, NC

## Emergency & Mitigation Services

- [Water Damage Restoration](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/water-damage-restoration): 24/7 water extraction and structural drying — truck-mounted extractors (200+ gallons/hour), FLIR thermal imaging, commercial low-grain dehumidifiers, high-speed air movers, daily moisture logging; handles Category 1, 2, and 3 water losses
- [Storm Damage](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/storm-damage): Emergency storm damage response and repairs
- [Sewage Cleanup](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/sewage-cleanup): Sewage backup cleanup — Category 3 (black water) losses
- [Burst & Frozen Pipe Repair](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/burst-pipe-repair): Emergency response for burst and frozen pipes
- [Basement Flooding](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/basement-flooding): Cleanup and drying for flooded basements
- [Mold Removal & Remediation](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/mold-removal): Inspection and testing, containment with plastic sheeting and negative air machines, HEPA vacuuming and air scrubbing, antimicrobial treatment, moisture-source repair, and post-remediation verification following IICRC remediation standards
- [Crawlspace Encapsulation](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/crawlspace): Free crawl space inspection, cleanout and drying, drainage and sump pump fixes, sealed heavy-duty vapor barrier, and a right-sized dehumidifier
- [Waterproofing](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/waterproofing): Waterproofing services
- [Duct Cleaning](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/duct-cleaning): Air duct cleaning services

## Reconstruction & Remodeling

- [Reconstruction & Remodeling](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/reconstruction): Turnkey rebuild after mitigation — drywall, paint, flooring, tile, carpentry, subfloor, siding, and finish work self-performed; plumbing, electrical, and roofing through licensed subcontractors; residential and commercial
- [Insurance Reconstruction](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/insurance-reconstruction): Rebuilds billed directly to the insurance carrier, with Xactimate estimates that match adjuster standards
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://www.carolinaprorestoration.com/bathroom-remodeling): Bathroom remodeling services
